task: Core #1186 U10A1: forward-only strict tenant-Pro Office SQL guards

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Source-only critical SQL security fix against exact 2026-10-14 main e0e25df; existing U10A1 plan reviewed against #1186/#1227 and newly merged U10A2 readiness migration check; no schema deployment or customer baseline mutation in this independent bounded unit.

acceptanceCriteria: The actual tenant subscription plan must be pro before private Office advanced and Team Chat SQL capability decisions are true; stale enabled row, organization override, manual/trial exceptions, missing current tenant, or platform operator alone may not bypass.
Active time-bounded entitlement must be present as a separate AND condition; revoked, disabled, expired or unknown rows fail closed.

All three browser Office table SELECT policies require current tenant Pro alongside existing per-user reader/participant restrictions, preserving internal Team Chat independent teamChat predicate and owner/participant semantics.

Customer Office thread access uses officeCommunicationAdvanced and support RBAC; internal chat uses teamChat and office.internal_chat capabilities. No credential-less public functions or extra Data API access.
No impact on basic Alap support, order/transactional emails, campaign and notifications outside Digitális Iroda. Existing tenant data preserved.
Existing privileged Office service-role RPCs, delegated actions, signed downloads and worker send paths must be mapped; any unproven path remains PARTIAL and separately tracked.
SQL syntax guard and privacy, Team Chat, entitlement tests PASS; current staging is not silently treated as migrated.
Full canonical Guard, Plan Before Code, edit-time Reference/Implementation Sync, Replay, Release Risk, CI, Truth, Lifecycle and postmerge main evidence required before U10A DONE.

The production migration is source-only until customer baseline parity U10A2, controlled target migration compatibility and Fresh Install are proven. This unit is PARTIAL, cannot be merged alone as final production closure.
invariants: Source of Pro truth is canonical webshop_instances subscription_plan plus active correct-instance entitlement; never profile, JWT user_metadata or default configured plan.
Tenant identity and actor support/team permission remain checked independently of plan.
Team Chat teamChat and office.internal_chat are not replaced by officeCommunicationAdvanced.
Revoke or downgrade fails closed immediately at SQL helper evaluation even if feature_entitlements rows stale.
No extra access for anon, authenticated, PUBLIC, or service_role outside specifically authorized existing pathways.
Production/staging schema and customer data are untouched by source-only development.

challenge.scenario: Manual/organization Pro entitlement survives Alap downgrade.
challenge.finding: SQL helper previously trusted stale entitlement only.
challenge.resolution: Check current webshop_instances.subscription_plan pro and active scoped grant; negative regression before deploy.

challenge.scenario: Platform operator calls a service-role advanced Office RPC for an Alap tenant.
challenge.finding: Existing SQL OR bypass grants access independently of subscription.
challenge.resolution: Remove unqualified platform exception on content RPC; preserve audited platform admin routes and deny Alap content.

challenge.scenario: RLS Pro predicate breaks internal Team Chat.
challenge.finding: Chat and customer office share underlying tables but distinct features.
challenge.resolution: Common strict tenant Pro and distinct type-specific teamChat/advancedEmail downstream checks.

challenge.scenario: Pro migration is applied on outdated staging with no privacy helper.
challenge.resolution: No target write; require ordered lineage real-rehearsal before production-like evidence.

challenge.scenario: Direct browser reads a customer thread after a legacy GRANT is restored.
challenge.finding: A PERMISSIVE SELECT predicate based on support role alone is insufficient.

challenge.resolution: Limit U10A1 to source migration and tests, mark dependent baseline parity U10A2 BLOCKED, no merge or DONE until full chain passes.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Live staging has legacy office_* RLS ALL policies and missing privacy migrations; repository SQL private.office_effective_feature_enabled_v1 treats stale enabled feature_entitlements as sufficient even after an Alap tenant downgrade, while office_advanced_actor_v1 lets platform operators bypass actual tenant Pro. On executing newer source migrations, direct authenticated SELECT policies and service-role RPC may allow out-of-package Digital Office access despite server-side Pro guards. This is NOT proof of a current exploitable staging browser SELECT since authenticated has no current direct table grant.
observableOutcomes: On a reproducible SQL fixture, current plan alap plus stale Pro enabled feature is denied by both Office advanced and Team Chat SQL helpers; valid current Pro with appropriate entitlement and actor passes.
All three Office browser SELECT policy surfaces compose tenant Pro requirement with participant/support role predicate; anon remains denied, and service_role guard is checked separately at each RPC.
An Alap webshop continues to use support, officeCommunication, order and transactional emails outside staff Office; independent Team Chat teamChat capability and participant privacy are preserved.
New production-line SQL migration parses in shared syntax guard; customer-baseline 0047 parity is separately BLOCKED in U10A2; no deployment or closure until dependency passes.
No shared staging or production database writes occur in this task; actual DB acceptance requires separate environment lineage and runtime proof.

Service-role paths may include functions and signing operations not covered by this bounded SQL release; parent issue remains PARTIAL.
Platform administrative exception policy for cross-tenant operational support may require separate explicit scope; no blanket exception remains in staff Office content.
SQL textual tests cannot replace live PostgreSQL policy, GRANT, SECURITY DEFINER and downgrade simulation; real DB acceptance remains required.

Customer Fresh Install baseline snapshot lacks modern Office privacy and advanced SQL helpers, so this main-only migration may not be merged/declared DONE until U10A2 resolves ordered baseline dependencies and verifies real Fresh Install proof.
